svg.title: 801, COUNTED IN X's
svg.text: A black longsleeve whose back is a tally of straight-edge X's that runs to 801, the area code,
one group of five at a time. A band-merch sleeve-and-back shirt with no band on it.
Alt: Salt Pink pigment-dyed body, Ink ink
Eight hundred and one marks, counted the way
you count on a wall: four X's and a strike.
One hundred and sixty full groups, then one
X left over. That one goes on the chest.
The wearer's left sleeve says the number;
the right sleeve is the straight-edge mark.
A letterer draws all 801 marks by hand in marker;
the file here is a stand-in with jitter.
